redactions.original: Because no exception to the imposition of the additional tax applies, we hold that petitioner is liable for it on the distribution.
received a taxable retirement plan distribution of $10,342

redactions.original: It is not applicable to the distribution petitioner received in 2018. And because it is not, petitioner is liable for the additional tax
Decision will be entered under Rule 155.

facts_from_discussion: Petitioner had not attained age 59 1/2 when she withdrew the money from her retirement plan in 2018.

Petitioner's only argument against the additional tax is that the withdrawal was made for economic hardship (emergency expenses); she relies on section 72(t)(2)(I), enacted by the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023.
Petitioner does not claim, and the record does not show, that section 7491(a) applies.
